_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: Consolidated interior specialty repaint covering 5 NC source specs: SF_WAINSCOT_PANEL_NC, SF_WOOD_WALL_NC, SF_WOOD_CEILING_NC, SF_ARCH_ELEMENT_NC, SF_BUILTIN_NC. Context prefix SPRP (SPecialty RePaint) confirmed — no collision with existing prefixes. Verified: zero TSK_SPRP_* IDs exist in id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use. Existing RP prefixes: WLRP, CLRP, TMRP, DIRP, WNRP, STRP, CBRP, DRRP, ALRP, WSRP, VNRP, TRRP. Existing NC prefixes for source specs: WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN. SPRP avoids all collisions.

paintable_items.name: Wainscot panel assembly
paintable_items.notes: Reuse from SF_WAINSCOT_PANEL_NC. Same physical surface in RP context. SF covers panels + internal rails/stiles + base rail + applied molding. Cap rail excluded (ITM_TRIM_WAINSCOT_RAIL via SF_TRIM_INT_RP). wainscot_type drives complexity modifier. Always H1 (below chair-rail height).

paintable_items.name: Wood wall panel/board surface
paintable_items.notes: Reuse from SF_WOOD_WALL_NC. Same physical surface in RP context. SF covers board faces, panel faces, internal rails/stiles (library_panel), joint detail. wall_style drives complexity modifier. Height varies via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND.

paintable_items.name: Wood ceiling panel/board surface
paintable_items.notes: Reuse from SF_WOOD_CEILING_NC. Registry uses ITM_WOOD_CEILING_PANEL (not ITM_WOOD_CEILING as research shorthand). Overhead penalty baked into per-task base rates (0.70-0.80x of equivalent wall rates). ceiling_style drives complexity modifier. Height modifier based on ceiling height (H1-H4).

paintable_items.name: Decorative beam
paintable_items.notes: Reuse from SF_ARCH_ELEMENT_NC. Running LF of exposed beam length. Typically 3 exposed faces (bottom + 2 sides). beam_profile drives complexity modifier (rectangular 1.0x, chamfered 1.10x, curved 1.25x, ornate 1.40x). Overhead factor ~0.85x baked into base rate.

paintable_items.name: Decorative column wrap
paintable_items.notes: Reuse from SF_ARCH_ELEMENT_NC. Each column counted individually. column_type drives complexity modifier (square 1.0x, round 1.15x, fluted 1.30x). Height via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND.

paintable_items.name: Fireplace mantel/surround
paintable_items.notes: Reuse from SF_ARCH_ELEMENT_NC. Each mantel counted individually. mantel_type drives complexity modifier (simple_shelf 1.0x, traditional 1.25x, ornate 1.50x). Typically H1-H2.

paintable_items.name: Built-in unit (consolidated RP item)
paintable_items.notes: NC uses ITM_OPENING_S/M/L/XL (per opening tier) + ITM_BUILTIN_DOOR (doors/drawers) — 5 separate items. For RP consolidation, proposing ITM_BUILTIN_UNIT as a single EA item representing a complete built-in unit. Size tier (S/M/L/XL) with depth/detail/access modifiers from Opening Count method drives rate selection. Door/drawer handling (removal, flat painting, reinstall) is bundled into per-unit workflow. This simplifies the consolidated spec from 5 built-in items to 1 while retaining rate granularity via size tier and modifiers.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_WNSC_* is NC wainscot (25 tasks). TSK_WDWL_* is NC wood wall (25 tasks). TSK_WDCL_* is NC wood ceiling (30 tasks). TSK_ARCH_* is NC arch elements (39 tasks). TSK_BLTN_* is NC built-in (35 tasks). TSK_SPRP_* is unique for consolidated interior specialty RP. Checked against id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use — SPRP not present.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_SPRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Per-surface-type tasks include surface suffix: TSK_SPRP_DEGLOSS_WAINSCOT, TSK_SPRP_DEGLOSS_WALL, TSK_SPRP_DEGLOSS_CEILING, TSK_SPRP_DEGLOSS_BEAM, TSK_SPRP_DEGLOSS_COLUMN, TSK_SPRP_DEGLOSS_MANTEL, TSK_SPRP_DEGLOSS_BUILTIN. Shared tasks omit surface suffix: TSK_SPRP_ASSESS_CONDITION, TSK_SPRP_WASH_TSP, TSK_SPRP_CUSTOMER_WALKTHROUGH. ALL tasks in this consolidated RP spec use the SPRP_ prefix — tasks adapted from 5 NC specs are re-issued under TSK_SPRP_* for prefix consistency.

expected_modules.notes: Shared room protection: floor coverage (perimeter for brush, full for spray or ceiling work), wall/ceiling masking (spray method), fixture covers. Built-in contents protection (RP-specific, conditional). Single setup covers all specialty surface types in the room.

RP-specific multi-surface condition assessment: visual condition scan, ASTM D3359 adhesion test per surface type present, coating identification (latex vs alkyd vs stain/clear) per surface type, moisture check on ceiling and wall surfaces. Assessment maps to 'prep' phase — no 'assessment' phase value in controlled_enums. Per-room base time + per-surface-type increment. FIXED time tasks.

Per-surface-type prep: TSP wash (shared), degloss per surface type (7 tasks — one per paintable item), scrape/feather (condition-gated per surface type), caulk assess/replace per surface type, mildew treatment (condition-gated). Mixed UOM: SF for wainscot/wall/ceiling, LF for beam, EA for column/mantel/built-in.

State-driven primer per surface type: SYS_PRIMER_ADHESION_INT (alkyd existing or adhesion failure), SYS_PRIMER_STAINBLOCK_INT (smoke damage — shellac BIN), SYS_PRIMER_MILDEW_INT (moisture damage), SYS_PRIMER_BONDING (stain/clear conversion). Conditional on substrate_state per item. No primer for SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT with good adhesion + latex existing. Per-surface-type application tasks with correct UOM.

Fine-finish interstage at all tiers: inspect coat, sand between coats (QT3 spot 220, QT4 full 220, QT5 thorough 320), patch/repair defects, clean dust. Per-surface-type rates for SF surfaces (different overhead rates for ceiling vs wall). Shared for EA elements (marginal rate difference). Runs between each coat pair.

Per-surface-type finish coat application. SF surfaces: spray (dominant for wainscot, wall, ceiling) or brush. EA/LF elements: brush (dominant for detail profiles) or spray (beams). QT-driven systems: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC (QT3), SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE (QT4), SYS_FF_PREMIUM (QT5). 2 coats standard, 3 coats QT5 brush per FFD 15.10.3.

Shared protection teardown (one pass covers all surface types), floor protection removal, fixture unmask, tool cleanup, customer walkthrough (RP-specific per-project fixed time). Single cleanup eliminates 5 separate NC cleanup modules.

Shared lead-safe RRP module. Conditional on PS_META.BOOL.HOME_PRE_1978. Shared across all interior RP specs. Pre-existing shared module — not owned by this spec. Specialty millwork is HIGH RISK for lead paint — wainscot, mantels, columns, built-ins commonly painted with lead-based paint before 1978.

paintscope_keys.notes: Registry key is PS_SURFACE_SF.WAINSCOTING (not WAINSCOT_PANEL as research shorthand). Required when wainscot is in scope.

paintscope_keys.description: Square footage of wood wall panel surfaces to be repainted.
paintscope_keys.notes: Registry key is PS_SURFACE_SF.WOOD_WALL (not WOOD_WALL_PANEL as research shorthand). Required when wood wall panels are in scope.

paintscope_keys.description: Square footage of wood ceiling surfaces to be repainted.
paintscope_keys.notes: Required when wood ceiling is in scope. All ceiling tasks apply overhead penalty rates.

paintscope_keys.description: Linear footage of architectural beams to be repainted.
Count of architectural columns to be repainted.
Count of mantels to be repainted.
Count of built-in units to be repainted. RP consolidation uses single EA per unit with size-tier rate lookup.
paintscope_keys.notes: NC uses PS_OPENING_EA.BUILTIN_SHELF.S/M/L/XL (4 separate keys). RP consolidates to single key with size tier as a metadata dimension rather than 4 distinct input keys. Size tier provided via PS_META.ENUM.BUILTIN_SIZE_TIER.

paintscope_keys.description: Built-in size tier (S/M/L/XL) per Opening Count method. Drives rate selection and modifier applicability.
paintscope_keys.notes: New PS key for RP consolidation. Replaces NC's 4 separate count keys with 1 count key + 1 tier enum.

paintscope_keys.description: Height classification for wall panels, ceiling, beams, columns. Drives height modifier (H1=1.0x, H2=1.30x, H3=1.50x, H4=2.00x).
Surface condition (GOOD/FAIR/POOR) for prep modifier application. Values from condition_scale enum.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP and SF_DOOR_INT_RP (proposed there first). RP-specific condition assessment driving prep intensity.

paintscope_keys.description: Interior substrate state classification (SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT through SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE). Drives primer selection logic.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP and SF_DOOR_INT_RP (proposed there first). For this consolidated spec, recommend per-surface-type state inputs — but PaintScope may provide a single room-level state. Estimation Engineer to decide granularity.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag indicating home built before 1978, triggering RRP lead-safe module.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with all interior RP specs. Specialty millwork is HIGH RISK for lead paint.

paintscope_keys.description: Contamination type: none, mildew, smoke, water_stain. Drives primer selection and treatment task activation.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP and SF_DOOR_INT_RP (proposed there first).

paintscope_keys.description: Full floor protection area for spray method or ceiling work. Rosin paper or poly sheeting.
paintscope_keys.notes: NC uses PS_PROTECT_SF.FLOOR_EXPOSED pattern. Proposing FLOOR_FULL for the full-room spray/ceiling protection scenario distinct from perimeter-only.

paintscope_keys.description: Perimeter floor protection area for brush method drip containment.
Count of fixtures to mask/cover (lights, switches, outlets, vents). Per fixture.
paintscope_keys.notes: Consolidation of per-spec fixture counts into a shared room-level count.

paintscope_keys.description: Exposed floor area requiring protection. Canonical consolidated input.
paintscope_keys.notes: Retained for cross-spec compatibility per registry consolidation.

paintscope_keys.description: Room count — drives per-room heuristics (assessment base time, customer walkthrough, fixed-time tasks).

quality_tier.notes: QT2 excluded — prominent millwork and specialty surfaces are scrutinized. Standard global QT modifiers: QT3=1.0x, QT4=1.3x, QT5=1.5x (not elevated like doors).

application_method.notes: Spray is default for SF surfaces (wainscot, wall, ceiling). Brush is default for detail elements (columns, mantels). Both supported globally. Roll is NOT valid for specialty millwork. spray_backroll not applicable.

sheen.notes: Semi-gloss is traditional millwork default. Eggshell valid for ceiling surfaces and built-in interiors (lower scrutiny). Satin is contemporary alternative. Gloss at QT5 only. Flat/matte NOT valid for specialty millwork.

phase.notes: Assessment tasks map to 'prep' phase — no 'assessment' phase value in controlled_enums. 'apply' omitted from values because spec uses prime/finish directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: SF for wainscot/wall/ceiling tasks. LF for beam tasks. EA for column/mantel/built-in tasks. EA_ROOM for per-room heuristics (assessment, protection). FIXED for project-level fixed-time tasks (customer walkthrough, tool cleanup).

substrate_state.notes: All 5 interior RP substrate states accepted. Output normalizes to standard SS_PAINTED_* per selected sheen. Different surfaces in the same room may have different substrate states — per-surface-type state input recommended. Does NOT accept SS_BARE (NC scope) or SS_STAINED/SS_CLEAR (stain/clear conversion handled as condition driver with bonding primer, not separate input state).

condition_scale.notes: Universal 3-level condition scale per controlled_enums.json. Drives prep pool modifier: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x.

consumable_category.notes: All categories valid for specialty RP. 'tool' covers contour scrapers, assessment kit. 'prep' covers TSP solution, deglosser, biocide.

product_role.notes: Primer = state-driven RP primers (adhesion, stain-block, mildew, bonding). Finish = fine-finish QT-driven systems. Specialty = shellac stain blocker, biocide.

yield_uom.notes: SF for coverage-based consumables. LF for beam-related consumables. EA for per-element/per-unit consumables. GAL for product yield.

protection_level.notes: edge_only for floor_perimeter (brush). full_cover for floor_full (spray/ceiling), wall_upper_band (ceiling spray), wall_mask_above_wainscot (wainscot spray). item_mask for fixture_covers. light_mask for opening_cover_lightweight.

floor_type.notes: RP ALWAYS has finished floors. Subfloor and partial not applicable to interior RP.

modifier_mechanism.notes: QT3=baseline (1.0x). QT4=selective_multiplier (1.3x on qt_scaled tasks — standard global modifier). QT5=selective_multiplier (1.5x) + additional_rounds (coat 3 brush per FFD 15.10.3).

surface_ids.primary_surface_note: wainscot_panel is representative for the first surface type. All 7 surface types are primary within their scope: wainscot_panel, wall_panel, ceiling_panel, beam_wrap, column_wrap, mantel, builtin_carcass.
surface_ids.notes: All surface IDs are existing in id_registry.json surface_ids entries_in_active_use. Primary surfaces: wainscot_panel (wainscot), wall_panel (wood wall), ceiling_panel (wood ceiling), beam_wrap (beams), column_wrap (columns), mantel (mantels), builtin_carcass (built-in interiors) + builtin_face (built-in doors). Adjacent surfaces: drywall_wall (wall above wainscot, adjacent to wood wall/built-in), drywall_ceiling (ceiling above wall panels, at beam/column junctions), trim_baseboard (below wainscot), trim_chair_rail (at wainscot cap), trim_crown (at ceiling-wall junction).

zone_ids.notes: Drop cloth at work area for brush method drip containment. Always required. Shared across all surface types in the room.
Full floor coverage for spray overspray and ceiling drip risk. Rosin paper or poly sheeting. Spray method OR ceiling work triggers full floor coverage. Shared across all surface types.
Localized work zone protection around individual architectural elements or built-ins. May be subsumed by floor_full if spray. Per element/unit.
Upper wall masking during ceiling spray application. Paper/plastic from ceiling line down 12-18 inches. Conditional on ceiling work present AND spray method.
Ceiling masking during wall panel spray. NOT needed if ceiling is also being painted (ceiling goes first). Conditional on wall panel work AND spray AND no ceiling work in scope.
Wall masking above wainscot cap rail during spray. Paper from rail up 24-36 inches. Conditional on wainscot work AND spray method. Not in id_registry entries_in_active_use — proposing as new zone.
Light fixtures, switches, outlets, vents — mask or remove. Per fixture count. Shared across all surface types. Conditional on ceiling OR wall work present.
Lightweight cover over door openings during ceiling spray to prevent overspray migration. Poly sheeting or paper. Conditional on ceiling work AND spray.

RP-specific — cover remaining items in built-in if owner did not fully empty. Poly sheeting per opening. Conditional on built-in work AND contents not removed. Rate per opening with size-tier adjustment.

material_system_prefix.notes: 7 material systems — 4 RP primers + 3 fine-finish. Three RP primer systems (adhesion, stain-block, mildew) shared with wall RP, ceiling RP, trim RP, door RP (proposed in SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP resolution). SYS_PRIMER_BONDING is existing (from SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT) — for stain/clear coat conversion in RP. Three fine-finish systems (QT3/QT4/QT5) shared with all NC and RP millwork specs. SYS_FF_GALLERY (QT5 architect-spec) available but typically overkill for RP — Materials Manager may include as optional. No new material systems needed for this spec.

shared_rp_consumables.name: Liquid Sander / Deglosser
shared_rp_consumables.notes: RP-specific. Proposed in SF_TRIM_INT_RP resolution. Chemical degloss for existing paint on specialty surfaces — preferred for grooves, overhead ceiling, and enclosed built-in interiors (less dust than mechanical degloss). Shared across interior RP specs.

shared_rp_consumables.name: RP Assessment Kit (Adhesion + Coating ID)
shared_rp_consumables.notes: RP-specific. Proposed in SF_TRIM_INT_RP resolution. Cross-hatch cutter, tape (ASTM D3359), mineral spirits, white rags. Shared across interior RP specs.

shared_rp_consumables.name: TSP (Trisodium Phosphate) Cleaner
shared_rp_consumables.notes: RP-specific surface decontamination wash. Proposed in SF_DOOR_INT_RP resolution. Removes hand oils, cleaning residue, wax (furniture polish on built-ins), surface contaminants. Shared across interior RP specs.

proposed_consumables.name: Mildew Biocide Solution
proposed_consumables.justification: RP-specific mildew treatment for SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE on specialty surfaces. Wood ceilings in bathrooms/kitchens are high-risk. Kills active mildew before priming. Not used in NC (new substrate is clean).

proposed_consumables.name: Fine Sanding Sponge (150-180 grit)
proposed_consumables.justification: Preferred for deglossing detail profiles (wainscot raised panels, beadboard grooves, column flutes, mantel profiles). Conforms to curved/profiled surfaces better than flat sandpaper. Not commonly needed in NC (flat sanding is adequate on new substrate).

proposed_rounds.description: State-driven prime + 2 finish coats. Standard RP sequence for FAIR/POOR condition surfaces requiring primer, or for stain/clear conversion requiring bonding primer.
proposed_rounds.notes: Most common RP round for surfaces with adhesion/contamination issues. Prime coat is state-driven. Interstage between all coat pairs.

proposed_rounds.description: 2 finish coats only. GOOD condition, no prime needed — sound paint with adhesion verified and compatible coating.
proposed_rounds.notes: Skip prime when adhesion test passes, existing paint is sound, and coating is compatible (latex over latex). Most common residential repaint scenario.

proposed_rounds.description: Prime + 3 finish coats. QT5 + brush per FFD 15.10.3 + FAIR/POOR condition.
proposed_rounds.notes: Maximum coat sequence for specialty surfaces. State-driven prime + 3 brush finish coats with thorough interstage at 320 grit.

proposed_rounds.description: 3 finish coats. QT5 + brush + GOOD condition.
proposed_rounds.notes: QT5 brush adds 3rd finish coat per FFD 15.10.3 even without prime.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for adhesion primer on previously painted specialty surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Previously painted surfaces absorb less primer than bare wood. Expect 400-500 SF/gal for flat surfaces. Materials Manager to calibrate per surface type.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for shellac stain blocker on smoke-damaged specialty surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Shellac primers have lower coverage than latex (250-350 SF/gal). Extra product needed in grooves and detail profiles.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for bonding primer on stain/clear coat conversion surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Bonding primer coverage ~350-400 SF/gal. Full surface — no skip-prime option for conversion.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for fine-finish enamel on repainted specialty surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Similar to NC fine-finish coverage. Previously painted substrate absorbs slightly less. Materials Manager to evaluate if NC COV_ profiles can be reused per surface type.

existing_modifiers_to_reuse.notes: Shared RP modifier. Drives prep pool: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x. Proposed in SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP, shared across all interior RP specs.
Shared RP modifier. Drives treatment task activation and primer selection. Proposed in SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP.

existing_modifiers_from_nc.notes: Transfer from NC SF_WAINSCOT_PANEL_NC. flat_panel=1.0x, raised_panel=1.25x, beadboard=1.15x. Applies to wainscot prep, prime, and finish tasks.
Transfer from NC SF_WOOD_WALL_NC. flat_panel=1.0x, shiplap=1.15x, T&G=1.10x, library_panel=1.25x. Applies to wood wall prep, prime, and finish tasks.
Transfer from NC SF_WOOD_CEILING_NC. flat_plank=1.0x, beadboard=1.15x, T&G=1.10x, coffered=1.35x. Applies to wood ceiling prep, prime, and finish tasks. Stacks with height modifier.
Transfer from NC SF_ARCH_ELEMENT_NC. rectangular=1.0x, chamfered=1.10x, curved=1.25x, ornate=1.40x. Applies to beam prep, prime, and finish tasks.
Transfer from NC SF_ARCH_ELEMENT_NC. square=1.0x, round=1.15x, fluted=1.30x. Applies to column prep, prime, and finish tasks.
Transfer from NC SF_ARCH_ELEMENT_NC. simple_shelf=1.0x, traditional=1.25x, ornate=1.50x. Applies to mantel prep, prime, and finish tasks.

Transfer from NC. H1=1.0x, H2=1.30x, H3=1.50x, H4=2.00x. Applies to: wood wall (height varies), wood ceiling (ceiling height), arch beam (overhead), arch column (tall columns), arch mantel (H1-H2). NOT applied to wainscot (always H1). NOT applied to built-in (typically H1).
Transfer from NC SF_BUILTIN_NC Opening Count method. Depth modifier: standard=1.0x, deep=1.30x, very_deep=1.50x. Applies to built-in prep, prime, and finish tasks.
Transfer from NC SF_BUILTIN_NC Opening Count method. Detail modifier: standard=1.0x, moderate=1.15x, ornate=1.35x. Applies to built-in prep, prime, and finish tasks.
Transfer from NC SF_BUILTIN_NC Opening Count method. Access modifier: standard=1.0x, limited=1.15x, restricted=1.30x. Applies to built-in prep, prime, and finish tasks.

max_theoretical_by_surface.builtin: POOR(2.0) x depth_deep(1.50) x detail_ornate(1.35) x access_restricted(1.30) = 5.265x

prep_pool.flag_notes: Ceiling coffered+POOR+H3 (4.05x) and beam ornate+POOR+H3 (4.20x) marginally exceed 4.0x flag. These are rare combinations — coffered ceilings in poor condition at cathedral heights, or ornate beams in poor condition at height. Built-in max (5.265x) exceeds 4.0x but requires deep+ornate+restricted+POOR — extremely unlikely combination. Flag for estimator review when any prep stack exceeds 4.0x.

coating_pool.flag_notes: All coating pool max stacks remain under 4.0x flag threshold.

coordination_notes: Specialty RP runs alongside trim RP (SF_TRIM_INT_RP) which covers cap rail (ITM_TRIM_WAINSCOT_RAIL), baseboard (ITM_TRIM_BASEBOARD), and crown molding (ITM_TRIM_CROWN). Painting sequence: trim same-color junctions can be done wet-on-wet with specialty surfaces.

Specialty RP may run alongside wall RP (SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP) and ceiling RP (SF_DRYWALL_CEILING_INT_RP) in full interior repaint. Sequencing: specialty surfaces should be coordinated with adjacent drywall — protect finished drywall during specialty spray.
Specialty RP may run alongside door RP (SF_DOOR_INT_RP) in occupied home full repaint. Shared protection setup in overlapping rooms.
MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT is shared across all interior RP specs — do not duplicate lead-safe tasks.
Protection zone consolidation: if multiple specialty surface types in one room, ONE shared floor protection, ONE shared fixture cover pass. Setup once, work all surfaces, teardown once.
Wainscot cap rail adjacency with SF_TRIM_INT_RP — when both specs active, cap-rail-to-wainscot tape line is needed only when different finish group.
Built-in contents protection is unique to this spec — no other RP spec needs contents removal.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: Every TSK_ context prefix from resolution.json MUST be used in sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 10: Every ITM_ marked 'existing' in resolution.json MUST use the exact registered ID
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from resolution.json applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Specialty Surface Repaint (Consolidated: Wainscot + Wood Wall + Wood Ceiling + Arch Elements + Built-ins)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family consolidating 5 NC specialty specs into one RP spec. Covers previously painted interior specialty surfaces in occupied homes. No existing SF_ covers interior specialty RP.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Built-in unit (consolidated RP item)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP consolidation of NC's 5 built-in items (ITM_OPENING_S/M/L/XL + ITM_BUILTIN_DOOR) into a single EA item with size-tier rate lookup. Simplifies consolidated spec while retaining rate granularity via size tier and modifiers.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Specialty Repaint Task Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New context prefix SPRP for consolidated interior specialty RP tasks (~45-55 tasks). Avoids collision with TSK_WNSC_* (NC wainscot, 25 tasks), TSK_WDWL_* (NC wood wall, 25 tasks), TSK_WDCL_* (NC wood ceiling, 30 tasks), TSK_ARCH_* (NC arch elements, 39 tasks), TSK_BLTN_* (NC built-in, 35 tasks), and all other RP prefixes.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Specialty Repaint Module Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New module prefix for 7 SPRP modules (setup, assessment, prep, prime, interstage, finish, cleanup) + shared MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT.
